title: Underline tabs
brief: A tab bar in a white card with a raspberry underline on the active tab, a tinted hover on the others, an inset focus ring, and a short panel below.

inspiration.note: Took the idea of a bottom rule with a thicker coloured line under the active tab; ours uses rounded line caps and a card.
Took the tab list plus content panel structure; palette, hover underline preview and focus ring are ours.
